claim: The ventilation openings on the back panel and underside of the tweezers must not be obstructed, to avoid fire or permanent damage.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 4 (PDF page 6). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
